description: XML plist whose URL contains & < > " and both numeric entity forms
notes: Every URL with a query string of more than one parameter hits this: CoreFoundation writes the '&' separators as '&'. A parser that hands back the raw slice between the <string> tags returns a URL that is wrong in the most common case there is. Decoded value: https://example.com/s?q=a&b<c>d&e="f"&gA
